sri_lanka_reviews.name: Alex Thompson
sri_lanka_reviews.comment: Absolutely incredible street food experience! The spices were perfectly balanced and the atmosphere was vibrant.

sri_lanka_reviews.name: Maria Chen
sri_lanka_reviews.comment: Amazing wildlife sightings including leopards and elephants. The guide was knowledgeable, though it was a bit crowded.

sri_lanka_reviews.name: Devid samson
sri_lanka_reviews.comment: Breathtaking eco-resort seamlessly built into the rock. The infinity pool and jungle views were unforgettable.
